units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:10">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>נעשו המים ז׳ וכ׳</he> the water in their bellies turned into semen.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:4:6">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נוטל הימנו ז׳</he> he may take seed thereof.
Shebi. II, 8 שזרעו לז׳ which he planted for the sake of obtaining seed, opp. לירק for using it as vegetable; a. fr.—Trnsf. issue, descent.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:5">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>; s. 51 <he>אותו ז׳ שהוא וכ׳</he> that issue which was to come from a foreign place (Moab).
<cite ref="Berakhot 31b:10">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ שמושח וכ׳</he> a descendant who will anoint two men; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְרָעִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:3">Peah II, 3</cite> <he>הכל מפסיק לז׳</he> all of them form a partition with regard to seeds (making each field separately subject to Peah), opp. to trees.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 3:2">Kil. III, 2</cite> <he>כל מין ז׳</he> all kinds of seeds (small vegetable), opp. <he>ירקות</he> large beans &c.; a. fr.—
Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ top ששה זְרָעִין six sowing seasons during a Sabbatical period.—סֶרֶר ז׳ or ז׳ Order of Seeds, Z’raim, the first of the six orders of the Mishnah a. Tosefta.
